title: Round changes
description: What changed in a round, `<design folder>/rounds/<design name>/<N>/changes.json`, so a person sees each change next to the comment it answers. The page marks a comment done once a later round answers it, and `open-prototype check` reports an answer that names no comment of an earlier round.

changes.summary: The button now says which items it saves.

schema_version.description: The version of the round files, apart from the version of what the tool prints; a file without it reads as 1. A newer one asks for a newer tool, and the check leaves the file out.

changes.description: The changes made in this round.

summary.description: What changed, in a sentence a person reads in the page beside each comment it answers.

answers.description: The ids of the comments this change answers, each from an earlier round of the same design.

screen.description: The screen the change shows on, by its `data-proto-screen` id: a note for whoever reads the file, such as the next reviewer. The page does not show it.

state.description: The state, by its `data-proto-state` name, with the screen: a note for whoever reads the file, as `screen` is.
